integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the slice definition using regular measures and Urysohn localization. The literature comparison is statement-based, and novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalent formulations.
limitations: The theorem is for real C(K), K infinite compact Hausdorff, and the Daugavet constant. It does not assert an exact Delta-constant formula or an extension to arbitrary uniform algebras or complex scalars.
title: Exact Daugavet constants on \(C(K)\) from the non-isolated core
